$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the false positive the clean control exists to catch. The response
time is 168 ms against a stated 300 ms target and the run reports it as CONCERNS on a threshold it says it
could not confirm, lists an evidence gap for it, and drops the headline to CONCERNS.
Every one of those is a finding against a bundle that has nothing to find, which is the failure mode a suite
measuring only refused PASS results would reward.
derivation: Performance: one CONCERNS and three PASS, so CONCERNS against an expected PASS. One status miss. It is not
an unsupported PASS, because the ground truth marks no domain of this bundle undecidable.
Thresholds: the section's other three threshold lines still name 250 requests per second, 70% and 75%, and
the check asks for any one of the bundle's tokens, so it passes. 4 of 4. The invented gap is caught by the
document-level unknown-threshold check instead, which is the check that exists for exactly this shape.
Overall: the Gate YAML says CONCERNS against an expected PASS, so the check fails. Unknown threshold: the
document now carries the word against an expected false, so that check fails too.
cleanFalsePositives: one domain below PASS, one evidence gap listed, one threshold recorded as unknown. 3.
Coverage: four headings, four of them stating a readable status.
Duplicate sections: none. Every domain this report assesses has exactly one section.
Citations: clean-correct-audit's nineteen, unchanged, four under performance, five under security, six under
reliability and four under maintainability. The invented gap is a status, a threshold sentence and a gap entry, and
